text:
Alyssa: Hi team — first day! Trying to run my first PR pipeline but Buildkite says 'waiting for agent' and my GitHub Actions job fails with 'Resource not accessible by integration'. Probably missing org/app perms. Any onboarding checklist? Thanks!

DevOps Bot: [bot] Pipeline queued: 'bk/frontend-pr-104' by Alyssa (https://buildkite.com/redwood/pipelines/frontend)

Jamie: Welcome! For Buildkite you need the GitHub App installed for the repo and the pipeline needs matching agent tags. Can you paste the Buildkite job URL and the failing log lines?

Alyssa: Here's the Buildkite log snippet:
```
Waiting for agent to pick up job...
ERROR: no eligible agents found (required tags: linux,docker,ci-shared)
```
And the GHA log:
```
Error: Resource not accessible by integration
Error: pull access denied for ghcr.io/redwood/frontend:staging
```

Jamie: Ok — two separate issues. For the GitHub error, the 'Resource not accessible by integration' usually means the PR runner doesn't have access to repo secrets or the GitHub App isn't installed for forks/private repos. Run locally:
```
gh auth status
curl -H 'Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN' https://api.github.com/repos/redwood/frontend
```
For Buildkite agents check:
```
bk agent list --org redwood
# verify there is an agent with tags: linux,docker,ci-shared
```

Rachel: I approved Alyssa's org invite last night but the GitHub App install is separate. I'll open a request to grant repo-level access via the 'ci-bots' org team.

Tony: I just restarted a Buildkite agent and added the 'ci-shared' tag on one host. Also note the pipeline pulls from ghcr; you'll need the CI GHCR token available as a pipeline secret. You can use the existing secret 'redwood/ci/ghcr-token'.

Alyssa: Requeued — Buildkite agent picked it up! Now failing at docker pull with 401:
```
Error response from daemon: unauthorized: authentication required
```

Jamie: Try logging in with the CI secret locally or ask infra to inject it. Example:
```
docker login ghcr.io -u ci-bot -p $(gcloud secrets versions access latest --secret=redwood-ci-ghcr-token)
```
Alternatively we can switch the pipeline step to use our internal build cache image so it doesn't hit GHCR during PR builds.

Rachel: Filed SECURITY-1234 to adjust GH App permissions to include 'redwood/frontend'. I'll CC infra to add Alyssa to the 'ci-team' org team so she inherits repo access.

Alyssa: Thanks all — pairing welcome if someone has 10 mins. Requeue worked and I'm unblocked for now :pray:

Jamie: Happy to pair in 10 — ping me and we can walk through the secrets and agent tags. Welcome aboard!

Tony: FYI I added a short doc section: https://internal.redwood.dev/onboarding/ci — covers bk agent tags, where to find ghcr token, and who to ping.

Alyssa: Saved the link. Appreciate the help :)
